attacks.name: Doomsday Chair Arsenal
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether the attack type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Psionic Assault
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance the defender |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Disorient|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Advanced Idea Mechanics (Affiliation: Criminal Syndicate)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, when an allied character is attacking or defending, if it is holding or contesting an objective token and has 1 or more |!wild| results in its roll, it may change 1 of its dice to a |!hit| or a |!block|.

superPowers.name: By My Calculations, You‘ll Be Dead in Seconds!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: All In This World Are Beneath Me!
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, if there is another allied character within |!range| 3 of it, this character may use this superpower. The allied character may spend up to 3 |!power|. For each |!power| spent this way, this character may reroll 1 attack die.

superPowers.name: Genius Requires Sacrifice; YOUR Sacrifice to Be Precise!
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an enemy attack, it may use this superpower. Choose another allied character within |!range| 2. The chosen character becomes the target of the attack regardless of Range and LOS.

superPowers.name: I am M.O.D.O.K., Master of the Mental Arts!
superPowers.body: While this character is defending against a |!mystic| attack, it adds Blanks in its roll to its total successes. Additionally, this character cannot be Pushed or Advanced by effects of enemy |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.
